description: Execute a workspace skill. Writes an audit row to skill_invocation. Skills can draft pitches, fact-check copy, cross-check Gmail history, prepare WARM reports — but they never approve or send anything. Pitches drafted by a skill enter the approval queue at /v1/approvals/queue; a human approves and sends in the TAP UI.

input.description: Skill-specific input object. Schema in tap_get_skill.io.input_schema.

name: tap_run_skill
